info.name: Transaction Execution API
info.description:
Tests for every endpoint of the Transaction Execution API.

Start the stack first: `docker compose up --build`.
The provider mock (WireMock) answers based on `accountId`: `acc-no-funds`, `acc-blocked`,
`acc-provider-error` and `acc-slow` simulate the failure cases; any other account is approved.

Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (or `newman run`) in order:
later requests reuse the `transactionId` and `idempotencyKey` saved by earlier ones.
